source_quotes.n_subjects: A shows the experimental schedule of CUS and LIPUS treatment, and behavior tests. B-C, latency time of exploring and eating in novelty-suppressed feeding test. Study measured transcriptomic and behavioural outcomes, not neural excitation/inhibition directly; coded as not_assessed.

readout_other: Novelty-suppressed feeding test; light/dark transition test; RNA sequencing (RNA-seq) transcriptome profiling; qRT-PCR validation
direction_notes: LIPUS reversed CUS-induced depressive-like behaviours and transcriptomic changes in hippocampus and PFC (e.g., reversed hemoglobin, GH-1 and GCK gene expression); direct neuronal excitatory/inhibitory direction of effect was not assessed.
safety_notes: Importantly, we observed no evidence of micro-hemorrhage, edema, necrosis, or inflammation following LIPUS treatment.

exposures.label: LIPUS to ventromedial PFC in CUS rats

timing.protocol_description: Ultrasound stimulation was applied to awake and freely moving rats in the CUS + LIPUS group, for twenty minutes each day for four consecutive weeks. The parameters of LIPUS were applied with 200 Hz pulse repetition frequency, 4% duty cycle, 0.2 ms tone burst duration, 1 second sonication duration, and 3 seconds inter-stimulus interval.
